normalizer.unicode: NFKC followed by controlled diacritic removal for Latin and Arabic text.
normalizer.whitespace: Collapse all Unicode whitespace to a single ASCII space and trim.
normalizer.punctuation: Normalize apostrophes and dashes, then replace remaining punctuation separators with spaces.
normalizer.arabic: Remove tatweel and harakat; normalize Arabic alef variants to ا, alif maqsura to ي, waw-hamza to و and ya-hamza to ي. Ta marbuta is not collapsed.
normalizer.latin: Remove combining diacritics after canonical decomposition; retain alphanumeric tokens.
normalizer.digits: Normalize Arabic-Indic and Extended Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII digits.
forbidden: merging two people because their normalized names match
